reason: Sleep is my thing right now and the lab report behind the QR code is more than most TikTok Shop brands bother with. At $24.99 with money back, I'll try one box on a whim, but I won't stock up.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, and the guarantee only counts if I finish all 30 sachets, which I probably won't do.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing a real week of using it, or a refund that doesn't require finishing the whole box.
